frontmatter.p: AN ACT TO AMEND AND EXTEND THE LAND PURCHASE ACTS AND TO MAKE PROVISION WITH RESPECT TO OTHER MATTERS CONNECTED WITH THE AFORESAID. [18th March, 1992]

sect.p: the Act of 1923 means the Land Act, 1923;
the Act of 1933 means the Land Bond Act, 1933;
the Central Bank means the Central Bank of Ireland;
the Minister means the Minister for Finance.
